name: @dpdp/desktop
description: DPDP Platform -- a thin Windows desktop shell around the hosted DPDP frontend (https://app.hhgoa.work). No business logic lives here and nothing runs locally: it opens a native window on the hosted app and adds native folder access and save dialogs for that one origin. Authentication, licensing, capability, tenancy, Gateway -- all of it stays exactly where it already is.

scripts.test: node src/storage-path-safety.test.js && node src/storage-fs-ops.test.js && node src/trusted-origin.test.js
